# SWAM

> SWAM is the modern way to discover and plan things to do anywhere in the world. Real products from real hosts, video-first, with itineraries you can build, share, and copy in seconds.

## Why SWAM
- **Things to do, perfectly indexed**: every product, city, area and country has its own canonical, fast page with structured data.
- **Itinerary engine**: build, share and copy multi-day trips. Public itineraries are linkable and reusable.
- **Hosts, not aggregators**: each product is tied to a real host with their own profile.

## Indexable surface
- /things-to-do/{city} — Things to do in a city
- /things-to-do/{city}/{slug} — Individual product detail
- /things-to-do/{city}/{area}/{slug} — Product within a city area
- /{city} — City landing page
- /{city}/{area} — Area within city
- /collections/{slug} — Curated collections
- /itineraries/{slug} — Public itineraries
- /hosts/{username} — Host profiles
